title: 2x Vanilla World Gen
description: Biomes 2x that of vanilla. Same world gen, more room to explore.
body:
# 2x Vanilla World Gen

Vanilla world generation, but every biome is stretched to double the width. Forests are bigger. Deserts go further. Oceans take longer to cross.

## Features
- All 5 climate parameters scaled: temperature, vegetation, continentalness, erosion, and weirdness
- Biomes 2x wider than vanilla in every direction
- Normal world type (no presets required)
- Part of the Vanilla World Gen series: 2x · 4x · 8x · 16x · 32x · 64x

## How to use
1. Install the datapack
2. Create a new world (Normal type)
3. Load in. Only affects ungenerated chunks.

## Notes
- Compatible with Minecraft 26.1.2
- Pure datapack, no mods, no executables
